methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Capability negotiation; returns protocol version, server info, and method list.

methods.name: repos/create
methods.description: Register a local git repository.

methods.name: repos/list
methods.description: List registered repositories.

methods.name: repos/get
methods.description: Get one repository by name.

methods.name: repos/setArchived
methods.description: Archive or unarchive a repository.

methods.name: repos/setFavorite
methods.description: Favorite or unfavorite a repository.

methods.name: repos/update
methods.description: Update a repository's default branch and/or local path.

methods.name: repos/rename
methods.description: Rename a repository's owner/name (full_name) (#485).

methods.name: repos/remove
methods.description: Remove a repository and its issues/PRs.

methods.name: repos/setMergeMode
methods.description: Pin the repo's PR-detail write action ('merge' | 'github_pr'), or 'auto' to clear it (#406).

methods.name: repos/mergeMode
methods.description: Resolved merge-mode view: raw setting, GitHub-remote presence, and the effective mode (#406).

methods.name: settings/get
methods.description: Instance-level config.json settings (per-agent autoModeOnBuild/model/effort, codingAgent, devCostLimitUsd) (#474, #499, #516, #593, #594, #682, #1027).

methods.name: settings/update
methods.description: Update instance-level config.json settings, preserving unrelated fields. autoModeOnBuild/model/effort require agent (#474, #593, #594, #682, #1027).

devCostLimitUsd.description: Per-task USD over-budget stop threshold for lh build agents. Omit to use the $10 default. JSON Schema enforces the positive and $1,000 maximum bounds; the service additionally rejects values with more than two decimal places.

methods.name: notifications/list
methods.description: List topbar notification-center alerts, independent from lh inbox.

methods.name: notifications/unreadCount
methods.description: Count unread notification-center alerts.

methods.name: notifications/read
methods.description: Mark one notification-center alert as read.

methods.name: notifications/readAll
methods.description: Mark all visible notification-center alerts as read.

methods.name: workflows/list
methods.description: List global workflow definitions (Plan/Execute/Verify/Reflect prompt bundles).

methods.name: workflows/get
methods.description: Get one workflow definition by name.

methods.name: workflows/create
methods.description: Create a global workflow definition.

methods.name: workflows/update
methods.description: Update a global workflow definition.

methods.name: workflows/delete
methods.description: Delete a global workflow definition unless a running run references it.

methods.name: workflowRuns/stateForIssue
methods.description: Display state of the latest Workflow run linked to an issue (status / current_step / rework_count / workflow), or null when none. Reads the run row only (#1008).

methods.name: workflowRuns/stateForPull
methods.description: Display state of the latest Workflow run linked to a PR (status / current_step / rework_count / workflow), or null when none. Reads the run row only (#1008).

methods.name: terminal/config
methods.description: Terminal launch backend, always herdr — terminal workflows launch as external Herdr sessions (#562).

methods.name: terminal/launch
methods.description: Launch a terminal workflow as a named Herdr session. issue-dev (Build) spawns `lh build --herdr` and lets it provision the worktree/PR and the herdr pane itself (#584); the other workflows are orchestrated by this RPC directly.

methods.name: terminal/sessions
methods.description: Running herdr sessions grouped by repository, with each agent's name and status (#495), plus which running agents are pinned to a PR's worktree (pull_workspaces, #579 — drives the issue-list Herdr badge). Empty when herdr is not installed or nothing is running.

methods.name: terminal/agentRead
methods.description: Recent terminal output for one herdr agent, for the sidebar hover preview (#500). target is a herdr `agent read` target — a pane_id, or an agent display name (e.g. "dev #486") only when it's unique within the session (herdr will not resolve an ambiguous name). output is null when herdr isn't running, the session is gone, or the agent is no longer present.

methods.name: terminal/killAgent
methods.description: Close the pane a herdr agent is running in, identified by its pane id (#521). Fails visibly (herdr not installed, session/pane already gone) rather than silently.

methods.name: terminal/focusAgent
methods.description: Switch herdr's focus to a running agent's pane, identified by its pane id (#578's herdr agent focus, reused by the issue-list Herdr badge's click action, #579). Fails visibly (herdr not installed, pane already gone) rather than silently.

methods.name: sessions/register
methods.description: Register (or update) an agent session.

methods.name: sessions/link
methods.description: Link a registered session to an issue or a PR (exactly one of issue/pr). Generalized attach point for session kinds beyond dev; idempotent.

methods.name: sessions/listFor
methods.description: Related sessions for an issue or a PR (exactly one of issue/pr), newest first, with per-row resume verdicts.

methods.name: sessions/list
methods.description: List agent sessions.

methods.name: sessions/costSummary
methods.description: Small per-coding-agent cost totals for topbar display, grouped by month/week/today.

methods.name: sessions/get
methods.description: Get one agent session by id.

methods.name: inbox/list
methods.description: List Inbox messages across repositories, unread first by default.

methods.name: inbox/get
methods.description: Get one Inbox message by id.

methods.name: inbox/read
methods.description: Mark one Inbox message as read.

methods.name: inbox/unread
methods.description: Mark one Inbox message as unread.

methods.name: inbox/archive
methods.description: Archive one Inbox message.

methods.name: inbox/unarchive
methods.description: Move one archived Inbox message back to the active Inbox as read.

methods.name: inbox/delete
methods.description: Soft-delete one Inbox message by moving it to the deleted state.

methods.name: issues/list
methods.description: List issues/PRs in a repository.

methods.name: issues/get
methods.description: Get one issue by number.

methods.name: issues/create
methods.description: Open a new issue.

methods.name: issues/update
methods.description: Edit an issue's title/body/state/labels.

methods.name: issues/addLabels
methods.description: Add labels to an issue.

methods.name: issues/removeLabel
methods.description: Remove a label from an issue.

methods.name: comments/list
methods.description: List an issue's comments.

methods.name: comments/create
methods.description: Add a comment to an issue.

methods.name: handoffs/list
methods.description: List orchestrator<->subagent handoffs for a ref, chronological (seq asc). Filters optional: pr narrows to one PR, issue to a generic issue, session to a session.

methods.name: handoffs/record
methods.description: Record a handoff: a parent's instruction (dir=down) or a child's return (dir=up). Binds to a PR and/or issue (one required) plus the recording session. Pass body for inline content (instruction/Verify report), or src+hash to reference a canonical copy (plan=PR, diff=commit) without duplicating it.

methods.name: labels/list
methods.description: List a repository's labels.

methods.name: scheduledTasks/list
methods.description: List a repository's scheduled tasks.

methods.name: scheduledTasks/get
methods.description: Get one scheduled task by id, with its recent run log.

methods.name: scheduledTasks/create
methods.description: Create a scheduled task (title, prompt, agent, times, optional model/effort).

methods.name: scheduledTasks/update
methods.description: Update a scheduled task's fields (only provided fields change).

methods.name: scheduledTasks/delete
methods.description: Delete a scheduled task and its run log.

methods.name: scheduledTasks/run
methods.description: Run a scheduled task immediately (Run now), without waiting for a registered time.

methods.name: pulls/list
methods.description: List pull requests in a repository.

methods.name: pulls/get
methods.description: Get one pull request by number.

methods.name: pulls/create
methods.description: Open a pull request.

methods.name: pulls/update
methods.description: Edit a pull request's title/body/state.

methods.name: pulls/files
methods.description: List a pull request's changed files (diff).

methods.name: pulls/fileAtRef
methods.description: Whole-file content of a changed file at the PR's base or head commit (#435), for the Markdown preview modal. `status` is 'ok' (with `content`), 'missing' (the file does not exist at that side — an added or deleted file), or 'binary'.

methods.name: pulls/merge
methods.description: Merge a pull request.

methods.name: pulls/recordGithubPull
methods.description: Record the GitHub PR a loophub PR was exported to (#406). Idempotent on the PR.

methods.name: pulls/createGithubPull
methods.description: Submit a loophub PR to GitHub as a Draft PR (#411): push the head branch under `branch`, open (or recover) a Draft PR, and record it. Atomic — a retry recovers a created-but-unrecorded PR instead of duplicating.

methods.name: pulls/pushGithubPull
methods.description: Push the loophub PR's current head to the branch of its already-recorded GitHub PR (#848), so commits added locally after the export reach GitHub without re-creating the PR. Records the pushed head SHA.

methods.name: pulls/markGithubMerged
methods.description: Close a GitHub-linked PR (and its linked issue) as merged, without a local git merge, once lh-worker's polling has detected the GitHub PR as merged.

methods.name: pulls/githubStatus
methods.description: GitHub-side status (draft / review / checks / comment counts / merged) of a PR's linked GitHub PR (#850). Fetched on demand via `gh` and cached; 404 when the PR has no linked GitHub PR.

methods.name: pulls/readyForReview
methods.description: Mark a pull request ready for re-review after addressing changes.

methods.name: pulls/debug
methods.description: Read-only debug dump for a PR: raw DB rows (issue/pull/linked issue/labels), git facts (refs, SHAs, diffstat, commits, files), reviews, comments, related events, and the dev session.

methods.name: reviews/list
methods.description: List a pull request's reviews.

methods.name: reviews/listComments
methods.description: List a pull request's line comments.

methods.name: reviews/create
methods.description: Submit a review (optionally with line comments).

methods.name: events/list
methods.description: Poll events (webhook-style) by id cursor.

methods.name: dashboard/overview
methods.description: Cross-repo top-page overview: recently created open issues, each tagged with its repo.

methods.name: stats/get
methods.description: Database statistics: per-table row counts, DB file size (WAL included), and per-repo issue/PR tallies.

methods.name: sync/run
methods.description: Sweep open-PR heads and emit pull_request.updated when a head moved.

notifications.description: A LoopEvent delivered to a subscriber.
